headline.en: Finance & management control student · French / Swedish · Master in Management applicant

en: I study the BUT GEA (Finance & Management Control option) at IUT Aix-Marseille, in Gap.
Between my first and third year I worked at Pfisterer in three countries: one month in Stuttgart, a year in industry in Sheffield, and an internship in Shanghai starting March 2027.
I am applying to a Master in Management abroad and to the International Finance programme at IAE Aix-Marseille.
